newsitem.title: INDIA: India approves foreign firms in power transmission.
newsitem.headline: India approves foreign firms in power transmission.

text.p: The Indian cabinet approved on Tuesday a proposal to allow private and foreign investment in the transmission of electricity, a government spokesman said.
An ordinance, or presential decree, was expected to amend existing laws to allow foreign investment, he told reporters. The ordinance must be approved by the parliament within six months.

"Power transmission has been opened for private and foreign investment. An ordinance will be promulgated to amend the Electricity Supply Act, 1948 and the Indian Electricity Act, 1910," the spokesman said.
The laws restricted power distribution to state utilities.
